function b27DayBit(iso){if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(iso||''))return '';const d=new Date(iso+'T12:00:00');if(isNaN(d))return '';const wd=['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'][d.getDay()],mo=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][d.getMonth()];return wd+' '+mo+' '+d.getDate()}
function b27WhenBit(iso){const d=new Date(iso);if(!iso||isNaN(d))return '';const wd=['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'][d.getDay()],mo=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][d.getMonth()];return wd+' '+mo+' '+d.getDate()}
page.new:
function b27DayBit(iso){if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(iso||''))return '';const p=iso.split('-'),mo=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'][+p[1]-1];return mo?mo+' '+Number(p[2]):''}
function b27WhenBit(iso){if(!iso)return '';if(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(iso))return b27DayBit(iso);const d=new Date(iso);if(isNaN(d))return '';return (window.SHARED_UI&&SHARED_UI.etDate)?SHARED_UI.etDate(d):new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric',timeZone:'America/New_York'}).format(d)}
